## Adversarial findings

SKIPPED (all backends unreachable)

Every configured backend was unreachable. The only backend in the chain, openai/fixture-model, returned HTTP 503 (fixture unavailable) and the helper exited 5 (primary reviewer skipped as unreachable). This build has no adversarial review. It ships on the Phase-1 review alone because the configured chain was unavailable, not because an independent reviewer found nothing.
